Terry Gibbs’ second interview occurred shortly after his 97th birthday and twenty years after his first session. He was interviewed via Zoom on November 5, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe I’m very, very, very pleased to have Terry Gibbs back with me for a second interview twenty plus years after our first one.
Twenty years. They’ve been good to you.
You haven’t changed a bit, Monk.
Thank you, I’ll send that check in the mail for you.
Oh no, you were ugly then, you’re ugly now. I love you.
Well you know what we’ve picked up right where we left off.
You know something wild? The last interview we did all I know is we laughed a lot. I remember that. We laughed a lot. Go ahead.
